goal: Coverage is one proof, not an audit log

summary.title: Coverage is one proof, not an audit log
summary.what: status --selector and find now prove requested-selector freshness against covering stored coverage (typically fresh all(root)) instead of re-fingerprinting every historical cwd/date_range row. collectStatus opens SQLite once. Default status JSON omits coverage[] and sourceInventory.cwdGroups; --inventory restores the old audit dump. Shared proveRequestedCoverage plus a SHLOG_DEBUG_TIMING probe make the deleted work observable.
summary.why: Warm status --selector all was ~0.55–0.6s and ~85KB because 61 coverage rows each got snapshotFromFiles and the JSON dumped cwdGroups plus the full audit. Coverage only needs to answer whether the current selector is still covered by a fresh implying selector. Extends int_19d3c24f (in-invocation collectFiles reuse) and int_d189e8a1 (source_file_meta_cache) without stacking another freshness cache.
summary.user_goal: Coverage is one proof, not an audit log

decisions.chose: Evaluate the requested selector against stored coverage using existing selectorImplies and fingerprint freshness. Collect files once for the requested root and snapshot unique covering selectors only (usually all(root) and/or the requested selector).
decisions.rationale: cwd and date_range rows cannot cover all(root), so replaying them cannot change the proof and was the 61-row cost. Fingerprints stay byte-identical because snapshotFromFiles and source_file_meta_cache are unchanged.
rejected: Trust stored fingerprints without a live covering snapshot
Prune historical coverage rows as the performance fix
Add another persistent freshness cache on top of source_file_meta_cache

decisions.chose: Compact proof: context + compact sourceInventory (no cwdGroups) + index + coverageCount + requestedCoverage when --selector/--cwd. Historical coverage[] and cwdGroups require --inventory.
decisions.rationale: The 85KB dump was an audit log, not the agent-facing proof. Empty arrays keep keys compatible; coverageCount remains so agents still see stored row count. --inventory preserves the old dump for debugging.
rejected: Removing coverage/cwdGroups keys entirely without a flag

decisions.point: How to open SQLite in collectStatus
decisions.chose: One withReadDb that loads coverage records, source_file_meta_cache, and index counts together.
decisions.rationale: The 705MB DB was opened three times per status (meta cache, coverage list, stats). Warm opens are cheap but the extra work and lock traffic were free to delete.
rejected: Leaving the three-open structure because each open is ~1.6ms warm

rejected.alternative: Bet 2 contentless FTS / DB shrink or Bet 3 sidecar metadata
rejected.reason: Out of scope for this change; coverage proof cost was independent and measurable on its own.

rejected.alternative: A watcher/daemon to keep coverage hot
rejected.reason: Violates the product boundary that Sherlog stays a CLI with manual incremental sync.

review_notes: Warm node dist/cli.js status --source codex --selector all --json on the 705MB local index: ~94–102ms, 2152 bytes, snapshotCalls=1, dbOpens=1. Prior diagnosis was ~550–600ms and ~85KB.
--inventory on the same DB: ~667ms, 85017 bytes, snapshotCalls=57 (opt-in audit still walks extra roots).
find coverage probe with 12 extra cwd rows: SHLOG_DEBUG_TIMING snapshotCalls=1.
JSON consumers that iterated default coverage[] or cwdGroups must pass --inventory or switch to requestedCoverage. Global shlog CLI is unchanged until a registry release.

architectural_claims: Coverage freshness for status --selector and find is a proof over covering selectors, not a per-row audit of the coverage table.
collectStatus opens the SQLite index at most once per invocation.
Default status JSON is a compact proof; historical coverage[] and cwdGroups are opt-in via --inventory.
behavioral_changes: Default status --json omits coverage[] freshness audit and sourceInventory.cwdGroups (empty arrays) and adds coverageCount.
status --selector / find snapshot unique covering selectors only; N historical cwd rows no longer multiply snapshot work.
status --inventory restores the old coverage[] + cwdGroups dump.
SHLOG_DEBUG_TIMING=1 prints one stderr timing line; it is not added to default JSON.

api_changes.signature: status --json coverage[] and sourceInventory.cwdGroups default to empty

migration_notes: Agents and JSON consumers that read default status.coverage or sourceInventory.cwdGroups must switch to requestedCoverage or pass --inventory.
No database migration. Fingerprint semantics unchanged. Global shlog remains the previous registry release until a normal npm publish.
